'''Marl Dak'win''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he could be found near the [[Thul Palace]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
